title: BABYLON X LOIS THE PIE QUEEN SHIRT
body_html:
Founded in 1953, Lois the Pie Queen is a proudly Black-owned restaurant known for its soul food and homemade pies. For 73 years, the restaurant has served the Bay Area under the same family ownership, building a legacy rooted in community, tradition, and food that warms the soul. As the family restaurant of Babylon co-founder Garrett Stevenson, this project is a tribute to a legacy carried forward through generations.
